findings.current: The instant I finished speaking, Jin Mukyung rushed at me.
findings.explanation: Jin Mukyung delivers the preceding line and rushes forward as soon as he finishes speaking.
findings.korean: “그게 무슨 뜻인지는 잘 모르겠는데…… 기분이 확 나빠지네.” 말이 끝나기가 무섭게 진무경의 신형이 쇄도했다.
findings.replacement: The instant he finished speaking, Jin Mukyung rushed at me.

summary: One sentence attributes Jin Mukyung’s speech to Jin Taekyung.
